description: Demo questions for the payroll cutoff dataset. The UI shows them as example buttons and tests/test_payroll_cutoff.py checks every 'expect' block against the engine.

questions.label: Belgian deadline
questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting payroll changes for a Belgian client?
questions.talking_point: One answer from the approved procedure (5 days). The deadline is marked conflicted because the FAQ (2 days) and the quick guide (4 days) disagree. For review shows the conflict, the duplicate and the outdated v1.

questions.label: Trust the quick guide?
questions.question: Can I trust the payroll cutoff quick guide?
questions.talking_point: The quick guide is never used as evidence: no owner, no date, unknown approval. It is flagged as a near duplicate with a different number.

questions.label: Correction run free?
questions.question: Is a correction run free for Belgian clients?
questions.talking_point: The procedure says correction runs are charged. The FAQ says free, so the correction run part is marked conflicted.

questions.label: Multiple versions?
questions.question: Are there multiple versions of the Belgian payroll cutoff procedure?
questions.talking_point: v1 (3 days, 2021) is excluded as superseded and expired and shows as an outdated version. Only v3 is used.

questions.label: Who can I ask?
questions.question: Who can I ask about the Belgian payroll cutoff rule?
questions.talking_point: Lotte Vermeulen, owner of the approved procedure, with her activity as proof. Marc Peeters from the old version is not suggested.

questions.label: Who decides?
questions.question: The FAQ and the procedure disagree, who decides?
questions.talking_point: The governance policy answers: the official procedure leads and its owner decides. Lotte and Eva are suggested.

expect.first_claim_contains: owner of the official procedure decides

questions.label: French deadline
questions.question: What is the payroll change deadline for French clients?
questions.talking_point: No approved answer: the French deadline only lives in a Teams chat. The tool flags missing knowledge and suggests Julien Moreau to capture it.

questions.label: Dutch deadline
questions.question: What is the payroll change deadline for Dutch payrolls?
questions.talking_point: 7 days from the Dutch procedure. No Belgian source leaks into the answer.

questions.label: German deadline
questions.question: What is the payroll change deadline in Germany?
questions.talking_point: Nothing is known, so nothing is invented: no claims, no expert, a missing knowledge item.
